title: Exact canonical IPv4 allowlist policy
summary: The application-layer Queue Fabric allowlist is a set of exact canonical dotted-quad IPv4 addresses. It is intentionally not a CIDR, DNS, hostname or IPv6 policy in dev5.
invariants: Reject empty addresses, CIDR notation, IPv6 syntax, malformed/non-decimal octets, leading-zero forms, out-of-range octets and 0.0.0.0.
A trusted peer must have a non-empty explicit allowlist.
Re-registering a peer rebuilds the listener-wide aggregate trusted-source set so removed addresses do not linger at the pre-authentication gate.
Do not silently broaden the application rule from exact IP to network range or hostname matching.

provenance.claim: Source implements canonical IPv4 validation and peer allowlist requirements.
trustPeer replacement rebuilds the aggregate source-IP set from current peers.
Documentation defines exact IPv4 policy and stale-address removal.
